title: Linear depletion broken: rewardPerSecond is re-anchored on every interaction, causing asymptotic (not linear) reward emission
rootCause: After each accrual step in `_updatePool` the rate is recomputed as `rewardPerSecond = (rewardBalance * PRECISION) / depletionDuration` using the post-accrual (decreased) `rewardBalance`. The depletion window is effectively reset on every interaction, so `rewardBalance` decays asymptotically (~ (1-1/e) over the advertised window) rather than linearly to zero.
knownIssueReference: lib/phlimbo-ea/CLAUDE.md: 'src/Phlimbo.sol -- PhlimboEA (V1, deployed). Linear-depletion staking yield farm. Has the V1 rate-recompute bug ... DO NOT MODIFY.' Profile §7 V1 / §12 routing hint.
preservedDetails: CODE-001 carries the full attack walk-through, remediation framing (V2 freezes the rate), and known-issue marker. Carried forward verbatim.
